p: Castle Street is the pedestrianised heart of Hinckley town centre, so MERKUR at 4a is surrounded by shops, cafés and pubs. It's a strictly 18+ venue. The town is small enough to wander on foot, and Hinckley station has trains on the Leicester to Birmingham line.

History buffs are spoilt round here. Bosworth Battlefield Heritage Centre, near Market Bosworth, tells the story of the 1485 battle where Richard III lost his crown. The Battlefield Line heritage railway runs steam trains from Shackerstone, and the Ashby Canal is lovely for a towpath walk. Back in town, the Concordia Theatre puts on local productions throughout the year.
